value.signature: fn validate_formation < H : ClosureHeader > (graph : & ClosureFormationGraph , history : & ClosureHistory < H > , approval : & impl ClosureApproval < H > ,) -> Result < () , ClosureGraphError >

review.body: { let expected = reconstruct (history , approval) ? ; let actual = graph . graph () ; let reference = expected . graph () ; if actual . node_count () != reference . node_count () || actual . edge_count () != reference . edge_count () { return Err (ClosureGraphError :: GraphMismatch) ; } if reference . node_indices () . any (| index | actual . node_weight (index) != reference . node_weight (index)) { return Err (ClosureGraphError :: GraphMismatch) ; } if reference . edge_indices () . any (| index | { actual . edge_weight (index) != reference . edge_weight (index) || actual . edge_endpoints (index) != reference . edge_endpoints (index) }) { return Err (ClosureGraphError :: GraphMismatch) ; } Ok (()) }
review.item_premise: Pure successor operation over public retained structure and explicitly supplied complete opening or approval evidence; it neither reads holder state nor grants authenticated inclusion. Exact public values and closed refusals may be recorded.
